name: The Grid
subtitle: Learn the two rules. Everything else is decoration.

name: The Field
subtitle: The board pulls back. Your line no longer goes where you point it.

name: The Burn
subtitle: The board stops trying to end you and starts trying to outlast you. Reach a shelter before the flame does.

name: The Dark
subtitle: The lights go out. You draw by the light you carry, and the board hides what it's about to throw.

name: The Hunt
subtitle: The board stops waiting for you to run into it. Hunters lock onto your line and close in — you can't just dodge, you have to lose them.
